messages.snippet: Dear Jonathan, Ahead of our call at 4pm, our mark-up (v3) attached. Headlines: liability cap landing
messages.subject: Project Juniper - our mark-up (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Jonathan,

Ahead of our call at 4pm, our mark-up (v3) attached. Headlines: liability cap landing at 137.5% (£5.375m Yr1); we've accepted deletion of the goods sub-limit but added clause 16.3 requiring a non-vitiation/waiver-of-subrogation endorsement in Wexbourne's favour; indexation at 3.5%; and we've accepted the 6-month convenience notice subject to recovery of unamortised mobilisation costs on early termination (to be reflected in the exit schedule).

Speak shortly.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Juniper - our mark-up (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Good call. We can live with 137.5% and 3.5% indexation. The non-vitiation endorsement is fine. On mobilisation cost recovery, Wexbourne will accept recovery of unamortised costs on a straight-line basis over the 4-year term - I'll send confirming wording for the exit schedule tomorrow. I think we're substantially there.

Jonathan
